results.title: Chinese, US Military to Sign Memorandum on Strengthening Contacts in Crisis - Reports
results.description: BEIJING (Sputnik) - The military in China and the United States have agreed to sign a memorandum of understanding as soon as possible to strengthen communication during crises and to prevent them, the China Central Television (CCTV) reported on Saturday.

results.title: Stones, eggs hurled at car of Mamata camp's TMC MLA Kunal Ghosh in Bengal
results.description: Kunal Ghosh, a TMC MLA, faced an attack on his vehicle in Uttarpara while heading to a meeting. Protesters surrounded his car and hurled stones and eggs, leading to a broken rear windshield. Ghosh condemned the incident, claiming it represented lawlessness and lack of police presence. TMC leaders accused the BJP of orchestrating the pre-planned attack, while BJP MLA Dipanjan Chakraborty described it as public response.

results.title: DGP Vinayatosh Mishra Holds Review Meeting on Law and Order in Sambalpur
results.description: #ଆଇନଶ ୃଙ୍ଖଳାକୁ_ନେଇ_ଡିଜିପିଙ୍କ_ବଡ଼_ବୟାନ ସମ୍ବଲପୁରରେ ପୋଲିସ ଡିଜି ବିନୟତୋଷ ମିଶ୍ରଙ୍କ ରିଭ୍ୟୁ ମିଟିଂ । ସମ୍ବଲପୁର ଉତ୍ତରାଞ୍ଚଳ ପୋଲିସ ଡିଆଇଜିଙ୍କ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାଳୟରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଛି ଡିଜିପିଙ୍କ ସମୀକ୍ଷା ବୈଠକ । ଉତ୍ତରାଞ୍ଚଳ ପୋଲିସ ରେଞ୍ଜ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଗତ ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ଜିଲ୍ଲାର ଏସପିମାନେ ଏହି ସମୀକ୍ଷା ବୈଠକରେ ଯୋଗ ଦେଇଛନ୍ତି । ରେଞ୍ଜରେ ଆଇନଶୃଙ୍ଖଳା ପରିସ୍ଥିତି, ନିଶା କାରବାର ଓ ବିଭିନ୍ନ ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗରେ ଚାଲିଛି ସମୀକ୍ଷା । ଅପରାହ୍ନ ୪ଟା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଏହି ସମୀକ୍ଷା ବୈଠକ ଅନୁଷ୍ଠିତ ହେବ । Odisha Police DGP Vinayatosh Mishra is holding a review meeting in Sambalpur at the office of the Northern Range Police DIG. SPs from five districts under the Northern Range have joined the meeting. Law and order, drug trafficking and other key issues in the range are being reviewed.
